question: How has revolving-line utilization trended over the last six months by industry sector, and where is it rising?
answer:
Revolving-line utilization has been flat at about 46% in 10 of the 12 sectors. Manufacturing and Wholesale Distribution are the exceptions: both have climbed about 3.5 points every month since April and now sit near 69%. That pushed total revolver utilization from 46.2% at March-end to 49.9% at September-end. Nothing else is moving.

**Utilization by sector (drawn ÷ commitment, month-end)**

| Sector | Mar-26 (baseline) | Jun-26 | Sep-26 | Change (pts) | Same-facility change (pts) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Manufacturing** | 46.0% | 58.6% | **69.1%** | **+23.1** | **+23.1** |
| **Wholesale Distribution** | 45.4% | 58.0% | **68.6%** | **+23.2** | **+23.1** |
| CRE Multifamily | 44.5% | 44.3% | 46.2% | +1.7 | +1.3 |
| Healthcare Services | 45.9% | 45.9% | 46.4% | +0.5 | +0.2 |
| Technology | 46.0% | 46.6% | 46.3% | +0.3 | +0.2 |
| Holding & Financial Cos | 46.3% | 46.2% | 46.4% | +0.1 | +0.1 |
| Public & Not-for-Profit | 46.5% | 46.5% | 46.4% | –0.1 | 0.0 |
| Energy | 45.9% | 45.9% | 45.8% | –0.1 | –0.3 |
| Transportation & Logistics | 46.2% | 46.4% | 46.2% | 0.0 | –0.1 |
| Professional Services | 46.4% | 46.1% | 46.3% | –0.1 | –0.2 |
| CRE Office | 46.3% | 46.6% | 46.1% | –0.2 | +0.2 |
| Retail | 46.4% | 45.9% | 46.2% | –0.2 | –0.2 |

The same-facility column only counts lines that existed in both March and September.

**Where it's rising**
- **When it started:** in the 12 months of history, these two sectors held steady at 45.7–46.2% from October 2025 through March 2026. They then rose evenly: 51.3% (Apr), 54.8%, 58.3%, 61.8%, 65.4%, 68.9% (Sep, combined).
- **These are existing borrowers drawing more, not new lines.** On lines that existed in both March and September, drawn balances rose $112.9M in Manufacturing (65 lines) and $75.6M in Wholesale Distribution (44 lines). Every one of those 109 lines rose by more than 5 points.
- **Every industry code in both sectors moved the same way.** Each went from roughly 45–47% to 68–70%: machine shops, industrial machinery, motor-vehicle parts, plastics/resin, grocery wholesale, industrial machinery wholesale and motor-vehicle supplies wholesale.
- **No line is near its limit yet.** The highest single-line utilization in September is about 73%, and no line in either sector is at or above 80%. Only 1 line in these sectors is past due and none are on non-accrual, so this is an early-warning signal and not yet a delinquency problem.
- **Other sectors look flatter-to-higher only because of new lines.** CRE Office, Healthcare, Technology and others added lines in July–September (69 new revolvers bank-wide), but utilization on their existing lines didn't change.

The pattern points to working-capital stress in the auto/industrial supply chain, possibly inventory build or slower receivables. Next steps would be to check borrowing-base and covenant headroom for these borrowers in the risk system and to rank the largest drawn-balance increases.

**Sources and definitions**
- Facility list (`LENDING.FACILITY`): revolvers are product code `RLOC`, "Revolving line of credit" in the product reference table (`REF.PRODUCT`).
- Monthly balances (`LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY`): utilization = sum of drawn ÷ sum of (drawn + undrawn), weighted by dollars. Drawn + undrawn matched the commitment on every row, and no line was drawn above its commitment.
- Sector: client industry code (`CORE.CLIENT.NAICS_CD`) mapped through the sector file (`BIZ.SECTOR_MAP`, v4, effective 2024 onward). Every revolver client mapped to a sector.

**Assumptions**
- "Last six months" means April–September 2026, measured against the March 31, 2026 month-end.
- The sector figures include all lines with a balance record that month, including lines later paid off, up to their payoff. The same-facility column covers only lines present in both March and September.
- I didn't use the risk platform; the question only needed the commercial-banking data.

sql.sql: SELECT * FROM BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP ORDER BY NAICS_CD, EFF_FROM
SELECT PRODUCT_CD, FACILITY_STATUS, COUNT(*), SUM(COMMIT_AMT) FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.NAICS_CD, s.SECTOR, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FACILITY_ID) n_rloc, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CIF_NO) n_cli
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO = f.CIF_NO
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD = c.NAICS_CD
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(f.PRODUCT_CD))='RLOC'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID) nf, SUM(IFF(DRAWN_AMT IS NULL,1,0)) null_drawn, SUM(IFF(DRAWN_AMT<0,1,0)) neg, SUM(DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b
WHERE FACILITY_ID IN (SELECT FACILITY_ID FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY WHERE PRODUCT_CD='RLOC')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT b.SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, SUM(IFF(ABS(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT-f.COMMIT_AMT)>1,1,0)) mismatch, SUM(IFF(b.DRAWN_AMT>f.COMMIT_AMT,1,0)) overdrawn, SUM(IFF(f.ORIG_DT>DATEADD(month,-1,b.SNAP_DT),1,0)) new_in_month, SUM(IFF(f.FACILITY_STATUS<>'ACTIVE',1,0)) inactive, SUM(IFF(b.DPD>0,1,0)) dpd_pos
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID=b.FACILITY_ID
WHERE f.PRODUCT_CD='RLOC' AND b.SNAP_DT>='2026-03-31'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.SECTOR, b.SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT)/1e6,1) drawn_mm, ROUND(SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT)/1e6,1) commit_mm, ROUND(100*SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT)/SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT),1) util_pct
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID=b.FACILITY_ID
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD=c.NAICS_CD
WHERE f.PRODUCT_CD='RLOC' AND b.SNAP_DT>='2026-03-31'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH b AS (
SELECT b.FACILITY_ID, s.SECTOR, c.NAICS_CD, s.NAICS_DESC, b.SNAP_DT, b.DRAWN_AMT d, b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT cm
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID=b.FACILITY_ID
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD=c.NAICS_CD
WHERE f.PRODUCT_CD='RLOC' AND b.SNAP_DT IN ('2026-03-31','2026-09-30')),
p AS (SELECT FACILITY_ID, SECTOR, NAICS_CD, NAICS_DESC,
 MAX(IFF(SNAP_DT='2026-03-31',d,NULL)) d0, MAX(IFF(SNAP_DT='2026-03-31',cm,NULL)) c0,
 MAX(IFF(SNAP_DT='2026-09-30',d,NULL)) d1, MAX(IFF(SNAP_DT='2026-09-30',cm,NULL)) c1
 FROM b GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING COUNT(*)=2)
SELECT SECTOR, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(100*SUM(d0)/SUM(c0),1) util_mar, ROUND(100*SUM(d1)/SUM(c1),1) util_sep,
 ROUND(100*SUM(d1)/SUM(c1)-100*SUM(d0)/SUM(c0),1) chg_pts,
 SUM(IFF(d1/c1 > d0/c0 + 0.05,1,0)) n_up5, SUM(IFF(d1/c1>=0.8,1,0)) n_ge80_sep, SUM(IFF(d0/c0>=0.8,1,0)) n_ge80_mar,
 ROUND((SUM(d1)-SUM(d0))/1e6,1) drawn_chg_mm
FROM p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY chg_pts DESC

SELECT s.SECTOR, s.NAICS_DESC, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(100*SUM(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-03-31',b.DRAWN_AMT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-03-31',b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT,0)),0),1) util_mar,
ROUND(100*SUM(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30',b.DRAWN_AMT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30',b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT,0)),0),1) util_sep,
ROUND(MAX(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30',b.DRAWN_AMT/(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT),NULL))*100,1) max_fac_util_sep,
SUM(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' AND b.DPD>0,1,0)) dpd_sep, SUM(IFF(b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' AND b.ACCRUAL_STAT<>'A',1,0)) nonaccr_sep
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID=b.FACILITY_ID
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD=c.NAICS_CD
WHERE f.PRODUCT_CD='RLOC' AND b.SNAP_DT IN ('2026-03-31','2026-09-30') AND s.SECTOR IN ('Manufacturing','Wholesale Distribution')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT IFF(s.SECTOR IN ('Manufacturing','Wholesale Distribution'),'Mfg+Wholesale','All other') grp, b.SNAP_DT,
ROUND(100*SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT)/SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT),1) util, SUM(IFF(b.DPD>0,1,0)) dpd_cnt, COUNT(*) n
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID=b.FACILITY_ID
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD=c.NAICS_CD
WHERE f.PRODUCT_CD='RLOC' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
